lines.en: My two legs carry me quickly.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉一样的喙朝下点着
lines.en: My parrot-like beak bobs down.
I trot along the forest edge.
The long quills on my tail sway.
I slip low through the ferns.
My toes grip the fallen leaves.
I look several times at every step.
I skirt a thorny clump.
The young follow me.

lines.zh: 我的小短腿倒腾得很快
lines.en: My short legs churn fast.
I head toward tender leaves.
I go two steps, then stop.
Leaf bits cling to my beak.

lines.zh: 我和同类之间隔着几步
lines.en: I keep a few steps from my kin.
I stand, head turning constantly.
I listen to the leaves.
I chew a small leaf.
My beak touches the ground lightly.
I turn my head to my tail.
My tail quills shake in the wind.
I crouch low.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看有没有影子
lines.en: I look up for a shadow.
I wait for a leaf to fall.
I blink once, slowly.
I have scratched the soil loose.
I nuzzle the one beside me.
The ferns here are tender.
I stop and listen a long while.
I tilt my head at you, wary.
You are much taller than me.
I take one small step back.
Have you come for the eggs?
I plant myself before the young.
My beak is not much of a weapon.
I only look; I do not move.
A parrot beak is just right for leaves.
I hop once, then freeze.
Crouch down, or I will run.
A small sound in my throat.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着几步蕨叶
lines.en: A few ferns stand between us.
I cry out and bolt.
I shudder all over.
Legs a little weak, but still standing.
I duck into the ferns.
That hurt badly.
I make myself very small.
I am still running.
I glance back once.
The young are calling me.
I must hurry back.
Those are fresh tender leaves.

lines.zh: 我闻到嫩叶，往前凑了凑。
lines.en: I smell tender leaves and edge closer.
I have already smelled them.
Is what you hold food?
Another step forward.
My kin are all watching.
This, I am not afraid of.
I stretch my neck out further.
Set it down; I will eat it myself.
Give me a little more.
You touched me and I bolted.
I bump into one of my kin.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得退进灌木里。
lines.en: The bump sends me back into the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还叼着半片叶子。
lines.en: Half a leaf still hangs from my beak.
I retreat behind the fern.
That bump was nothing.
I stepped on your foot.
I flick my tail once.
Only once steady do I look at you.
You are far sturdier than me.
I touch my beak to yours.
We lower our heads and graze together.
The young are at our feet.
I watch this side; you watch that.
Our tail quills brush.

lines.zh: 林子安静下来了，幼崽都躲好了。
lines.en: The grove went quiet; the young are hidden.
I will look after them.
With you here, I am less afraid.
Let us wander for tender leaves.
By no means get separated.
I grip it in my beak and drag it back.
This is edible.
I chew once to test it.
This is a bit too dry.
I drop it for the young.
This cannot be eaten.
I push it; it rolls.
I carry it two steps and run.
This is a bit too hard.
Let me taste a little first.
I hear your sound.
I am on alert at once.
I herd the young behind me.
I do not like being this close.
I turn sideways, ready to run.
My tail quills lift a little.
I know a path behind the trees.

lines.zh: 你要不是来抢东西的,就走开
lines.en: If you are not here to take, then go.

lines.zh: 别的物种的幼崽，我也带。
lines.en: I raise other species' young too.
My kin have all looked up.
I retreat one more step.

lines.zh: 我把幼崽往身后拢了拢。
lines.en: I nudge my young behind me.
I open my beak, only to bluff.

lines.zh: 后面的路我闭着眼都会走
lines.en: I could walk the way back blind.
I never let you out of my sight.
You take a step; I take one back.
The young are hidden in the ferns.
I know which way leads out.

lines.zh: 我的喙朝下点着，一路小跑。
lines.en: Beak bobbing down, I trot along.
I will not turn my back.
I wait for a gap.
You are nearing my nest.
My feet shift in place.
I am small, but I run fast.
Any closer and I will call.
Head low, beak forward.
I wait for your first mistake.
I am nearly at my limit.
I crouch low, tail to the ground.
I peck at you with my beak.

lines.zh: 我替别的幼崽挡了一下。
lines.en: I took the blow for another's young.
I bite down on your knuckles.
That was very light.

lines.zh: 我低着头，用硬喙顶你的小腿。
lines.en: Head low, I butt your shin with my hard beak.
I hold my ground for the young.
My tail quills sweep your leg.
I am bounced back.
I am panting very fast.
This is not my strength.
I only want you to leave.
I am still calling.
I butt at your boot.
My beak cannot grip anything hard.
I push out of the ferns.
I shake off the leaf bits.
My beak comes out first.
I look up at the woods.
The young are with me.
I take a careful first step.
The long pale quills are behind me.
The ground here is soft.
I head for the tender leaves.
I hear my kin calling.
I answer at once.
I stop again and look around.
This wood is ours.
I lower my head and hurry off.
I listened a long while before stepping out.
A kin answers me from behind the tree.
I cross a layer of wet leaves.

lines.zh: 小个子的影子很容易被忽略
lines.en: A small shadow is easily overlooked.
Ferns and my quills scorch.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉似的嘴，啃嫩枝最好用。
lines.en: A parrot beak is best for tender shoots.
Water closes over my beak.
The blast throws me into the ferns.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我的尾
lines.en: Something sticks in my tail.
That light leaves me unsteady.
Too hungry even to run.
Lightning makes me jerk all over.
There is no ground underfoot.
